themes_detail.label: Sanitation Crisis Spike
themes_detail.summary: Unsanitary conditions complaints nearly tripled this week (16 complaints last week vs. 5.8 weekly average over prior 8 weeks), alongside a 344% spike in animal waste complaints on private property (5 vs. 1.1 average)—suggesting a coordinated sanitation breakdown in Tottenville/Great Kills that aligns with the community board's long-standing request for increased illegal dumping enforcement.
evidence: Unsanitary Condition complaints: 16 this week vs. 5.8 weekly average (z-score: 3.82, +178%)
Unsanitary Animal Pvt Property complaints: 5 this week vs. 1.1 weekly average (z-score: 3.05, +344%)
Community board has repeatedly requested increased illegal dumping enforcement from Department of Sanitation
reporting_angles: Interview residents about what sanitation issues they're seeing and whether they've filed 311 complaints
Contact DSNY to ask if there's a staffing shortage, missed collections, or known dumping hotspot in the district this week

themes_detail.label: Sudden Tree-Planting Demand Surge
themes_detail.summary: New Tree Requests exploded 1900% this week (5 complaints last week vs. 0.2 weekly average), the largest spike in the dataset by z-score (10.97), suggesting either a community organizing push, a perceived canopy loss event, or a response to the community board's long-standing request for forestry services.
evidence: New Tree Request complaints: 5 this week vs. 0.2 weekly average (z-score: 10.97, +1900%)
Community board has repeatedly requested forestry services and street tree maintenance from Parks Department
Damaged Tree complaints remain high at 429 total over 90 days, suggesting ongoing canopy stress
reporting_angles: Identify what triggered the sudden jump in tree requests—did residents meet to push for planting?
Interview Parks Department about response capacity and any tree loss event in the district

themes_detail.label: Building Violations & Code Issues Rising
themes_detail.summary: Building/Use complaints more than doubled this week (25 complaints last week vs. 11.2 weekly average) and Maintenance/Facility complaints jumped 122% (10 vs. 4.5), alongside 762 total DOB building permits filed in 90 days, suggesting property condition problems or a compliance enforcement surge in this area.
evidence: Building/Use complaints: 25 this week vs. 11.2 weekly average (z-score: 3.62, +122%)
Maintenance or Facility complaints: 10 this week vs. 4.5 weekly average (z-score: 3.67, +122%)
762 total DOB permits filed in last 90 days (384 alterations, 289 new buildings, 38 demolitions)
reporting_angles: Pull DOB permit data to identify which properties are under construction or in violation
Interview residents about unfinished renovations, unsafe conditions, or noisy construction sites

themes_detail.label: Missing Street Signs & Infrastructure Decay
themes_detail.summary: Missing Street Sign complaints spiked 269% three weeks ago (6 complaints vs. 1.6 weekly average) and Lot Condition complaints jumped 540%, indicating broader public realm maintenance gaps that align with the community board's repeated requests for street reconstruction from the Department of Transportation.
evidence: Street Sign - Missing complaints: 6 three weeks ago vs. 1.6 weekly average (z-score: 3.94, +269%)
Lot Condition complaints: 4 three weeks ago vs. 0.6 weekly average (z-score: 3.94, +540%)
Community board has repeatedly requested street reconstruction from DOT
reporting_angles: Map the clusters of missing sign complaints to identify specific corridors in disrepair
Ask DOT about maintenance backlog and timeline for street reconstruction in Tottenville/Great Kills
